verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs describe capturing traces of model calls over OpenTelemetry/OTLP, with zero-config auto-instrumentation for major frameworks and manual tracing decorators. They also explicitly cover identifying slow LLM invocations (latency) and giving a detailed breakdown of token usage per LLM call, with span replay of LLM invocations implying captured inputs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that trace spans record LLM inputs and outputs (only implied), and independent hands-on corroboration of the tracing data captured.
